detectors.fixed-limit-115C: naive warning light: >= 115 C for 2 consecutive samples; no reference, time or quality logic
detectors.v0.1-as-shipped: frozen v0.1 rule on raw rows; the run fails if v0.1 rejects any row
detectors.v0.1-cleaned: frozen v0.1 rule after oracle-free cleaning (drop unparseable rows, sort, de-duplicate)
detectors.v0.2-fixed-4C: ablation: plain fixed 4 C threshold (what does the robust scale add?)

H1.claim: v0.2 raises fewer false alerts than v0.1 on normal operation (per eligible hour and per trip), with coverage >= floor
H1.evidence: false alerts per 1000 eligible h: v0.2 0 (<= 14.081 if independent) vs v0.1 5443.244 [4949.7246, 5952.4888]; trips with a false alert: v0.2 0.0 vs v0.1 1.0; v0.2 coverage 0.3449

H2-original.claim: as first pre-registered: v0.2 abrupt recall >= v0.1 and drift detected at a smaller bias (raw recall; no placebo control)
H2-original.evidence: abrupt recall v0.2 0.9 vs v0.1 1.0; median bias at detection v0.2 4.257 C vs v0.1 0.563 C

H2a.claim: v0.2 demonstrably detects abrupt anomalies (24 h horizon), not worse than v0.1 by more than 0.1 excess recall (direction-aware, placebo-controlled)
H2a.evidence: v0.2 recall 0.9 placebo 0.0 excess 0.9 [0.6667, 1.0]; v0.1 recall 1.0 placebo 0.6 excess 0.4 [0.2, 0.6]

H2b.claim: v0.2 demonstrably detects gradual drift, not worse than v0.1 by more than 0.1 excess recall (direction-aware, placebo-controlled)
H2b.evidence: v0.2 recall 1.0 placebo 0.0 excess 1.0 [1.0, 1.0]; v0.1 recall 0.9 placebo 0.7 excess 0.2 [-0.1527, 0.5]

H3.claim: without a load signal, load increases cause false alerts; with it v0.2 avoids them while still assessing the affected rows
H3.evidence: false alerts per 1000 eligible h: v0.2 0 (<= 14.081 if independent), v0.2-no-load 114.514 [33.0203, 213.2787]; v0.2 coverage on towing rows 0.0231, v0.2-no-load 0.4248
H3.verdict: supported only by abstention (coverage on towing rows 0.0231)

H4.claim: v0.2 reduces false reassurance ('normal' while the sensor is frozen) without more trips with false alerts, with coverage >= floor
H4.evidence: false reassurance v0.2 0.0049 [0.0015, 0.0085] vs v0.1 0.76 [0.4641, 0.9062]; stuck rule off 0.272; frozen sensor with 1-LSB flicker: v0.2 0.0149

H5.claim: unseen vehicles: v0.2 never reports 'normal' (a design property, true by construction)
H5.evidence: normal rows on vehicles without reference: v0.2 0, v0.1 0

H6.claim: (expected negative) severe cold outlasts warmup_s and raises v0.2 false alerts
H6.evidence: v0.2 false alerts per 1000 eligible h: cold season 15.536 (2 alerts), hot season 75.052 (10 alerts), normal operation 0 (<= 14.081 if independent)

H7.claim: (expected negative) a fault present during the whole reference period is missed by the relative barrier
H7.evidence: relative barrier only (v0.2-no-absolute): {'overheat_in_reference_full': '0/4', 'overheat_in_reference_partial': '4/4'}; with the absolute barrier (v0.2): {'overheat_in_reference_full': '0/4', 'overheat_in_reference_partial': '4/4'}

notice: Synthetic data generated by the same project that wrote the detector. These numbers verify behaviour against documented assumptions; they are not evidence of real-world accuracy and say nothing about failure prediction.

abrupt_anomaly.description: v0-v2 cooling failure (overheat, strongest at low speed); v3-v4 thermostat stuck open (runs cold); v5-v7 controls.

contaminated_reference.description: v0-v1 overheat starts in the last 30 % of the reference period; v2-v3 during the whole reference period.

data_integrity.description: All vehicles: duplicates, conflicting duplicates, late rows, mixed UTC offsets; v0-v2 overheat.

gradual_sensor_drift.description: v0-v4 coolant sensor bias drifts 0.3-1.0 C/day (alternating sign); v5-v7 controls.

load_change.description: False-positive condition: v0-v4 start towing (+20-35 % load, legitimately hotter); v5-v7 controls.

normal_operation.description: Negative control: multi-regime driving, cold starts, hills; no injected events.

seasonal_shift.description: False-positive condition: v0-v3 hot season (+15-20 C ambient); v4-v7 severe cold (-25-30 C, longer warm-up than the detector assumes).

stress_abrupt_noise_x2.description: Robustness: abrupt anomalies with twice the sensor noise.

stress_noise_x2.description: Robustness: normal operation with twice the sensor noise.

stress_sampling_60s.description: Robustness: abrupt anomalies sampled every 60 s instead of 30 s.

stress_slow_warmup_x0.5.description: Sensitivity: normal operation with warm-up heating at 0.5x.

stress_slow_warmup_x0.6.description: Sensitivity: normal operation with warm-up heating at 0.6x (warm-up longer than the detector's window).

stress_stuck_flicker.description: Sensitivity: three sensors freeze but flicker by 1 LSB (evades bit-identical stuck rules); no other noise.

stress_subtle_overheat.description: Sensitivity: five vehicles overheat by only 3-7 C at idle (about the detection threshold).

unreliable_sensor.description: All vehicles: 5 % missing readings, 0.4 % spikes/sentinels; v0-v2 sensor freezes.

unseen_vehicles_and_regimes.description: v0-v2 have no reference data (v0 overheats); v3-v5 reference lacks highway driving (v4 overheats).
